insight: Granola records your computer's own audio instead of sending a bot into the call, so nothing shows up as a notetaker in the meeting.
name: Granola
tagline: AI notepad for back-to-back meetings — captures your Mac's audio, no meeting bot.
description: A desktop notepad that captures your computer's audio during calls and enhances your rough notes into structured summaries afterward. Because it records the system's own audio rather than dispatching a bot into the meeting, there's no visible notetaker for participants. Includes shared folders, custom templates, and an AI chat over your notes.

changelog.summary: Recategorized from voice to the new meeting category for notetakers/transcription.

edge: Captures system audio with no bot in the call, then blends your raw notes into the AI summary.
pros: Polished notes from your own context
cons: Free tier limits history and integrations
